Results.ReviewText: Neighbor raved about his 6yr old spirit 2 grill for years. So, I decided to try one. I purchased a spirit2 lp grill. It cooks fantasticly! Easy clean up, to. One glaring problem, there is no mobility with this grill. I have a "niche" on my patio for the grill. However, with only 2 wheels, which do not caster, it is impossible to move the grill without lifting it up. Furthermore, there is no handle to help move it! The folding shelf cannot be used to move because it is too flimsy, and prone to bending! For the price I paid, one would think a better designed grill would be easier to move. A recent back operation has me enlisting help to move the grill for cooking. Bad scene. My neighbors grill {an older spirit 2 } has 4 castering wheels and moves easily! I am not satisfied with my purchase.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText: We purchased this as there are only three of us now we needed a smaller simpler reliable unit to replace our older, larger, broken one. This BBQ is exactly that. What sold us was the guarantee. 10 year guarantee is amazing - obviously a product the company stands behind. My husband loves cooking on it - clean up is easy too and I love the red colour. Definitely highly recommend.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are so happy to hear you like the performance of your new Spirit II! 44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
